note: Each cell's encoded.js is the VM encoder's output for its source.js with default options, which draw no randomness, with the leading disassembly comment block removed (the committed corpus format). Regenerating with the same encoder revision reproduces the bytes.

cells.forms: one function per loop whose test is a compound condition compiled as short-circuit branches: while with && and ||, for with && and a negated nested &&, a for with no update walking a chain, do-while with ||, and nested fors with compound tests; each run with inputs that take every path
